packets.name: New Player Kit
packets.summary: Everything somebody coming to their first event needs on paper: how a weekend runs, what to bring, and the two chapters about playing with other people.

packets.name: Combat Card
packets.summary: The calls, the damage types and the states, printed dense enough to fold into a pouch. This one is the Combat Quick Reference page exactly as it already prints, so it is a link to that page rather than an assembly.

packets.name: NPC Packet
packets.summary: For somebody spending a shift in the NPC camp: what NPCing is, the rules that decide a fight, the calls, and the etiquette that holds across both sides of the line.
